Species models used by the SENYAS plant and animal scan (all run on the device).

general.tflite   EfficientNet-Lite0 image classifier (ImageNet, 1,000 classes), from the MediaPipe model collection. Apache License 2.0.
plants.tflite    MobileNet V2 trained on iNaturalist plants (2,101 species + background), from google-coral/test_data. Apache License 2.0.
birds.tflite     MobileNet V2 trained on iNaturalist birds (964 species + background), from google-coral/test_data. Apache License 2.0.
insects.tflite   MobileNet V2 trained on iNaturalist insects (1,021 species + background), from google-coral/test_data. Apache License 2.0.
labels.json      Scientific and common names for the three iNaturalist models, from the label files in google-coral/test_data.
